name: commerce
description: Garden commerce cap: lock-page purchase zone, /purchase/, /pricing/, and /privacy/. Product data is fetched at runtime from GET /v1/public/commerce/offers. Params are plugin-owned (params.commerce shell).
entry: layouts/_default/purchase.html, pricing.html, privacy.html | partial:access-card.html purchase slot | partial:commerce-privacy-link.html

params.description: projects.id (p_<hex>); empty before first publish — purchase zone stays hidden.

css.note: Set --mdf-commerce-* variables; do not fork the file.

js.note: Lock-page offers, checkout confirm, /purchase/ four states, /pricing/, /privacy/ runtime fill.

assets.size_impact: ~18KB uncompressed; scripts request offers only when params.commerce.project and endpoint are set

locked.reason: commerce.js and the public commerce API depend on these ids. Themes may style them; never rename.

partials.note: Must keep locked access and commerce ids.
Place in the family footer; do not rename the href source.

activation_pattern.template: "capabilities": { "commerce": true }  // garden families ship this cap; params.commerce is plugin-owned and never generated from the catalog
